title: Two-person natal synastry and traceable pair reports
description: Engine 0.7.0-alpha.1. Optional composite adds chart C and symbolic calculation metadata; omitted preserves the previous synastry shape. Two independent natal charts with subject-local advanced facts, a qualified shared cross context and six builtin pair profiles. New pair objects reject unknown fields. Subject natal/context facts reuse the individual contract. ID/index joins and cross-field consistency are checked by the development validator. Error responses have data:null. External urn references are registered from local repository schemas, never downloaded.
